objective: Improve cold and warm dependency resolution time on the frozen offline wheel index without changing exact locks or selected distributions.
build: cargo test --locked --offline -p uv-resolver --profile profiling; cargo build --locked --offline --profile profiling --bin uv --no-default-features (Rust 1.97.0, rust-lld, vendored dependencies)
workload: uv pip compile cold and warm against a hash-pinned PEP 503 file:// index; Manifest/Resolver execution follows crates/uv-bench/benches/uv.rs and cache preparation follows scripts/benchmark/src/benchmark/resolver.py
hardGates: selected wheel filenames and SHA-256 digests are exact
peak resolver RSS is no greater than the frozen baseline plus 2%
